name: Draw Blood
text:
The palm of your hand grows a mouth with impossibly long fangs that ache to drink your enemies' blood. Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, you deal 4d4 piercing damage and 2 persistent bleed damage (or double damage on a critical hit). For the duration of the spell, you regain max(2,@item.rank) vitality,healing Hit Points each time the target takes bleed damage.

---
Heightened (+1) The piercing damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage and healing increase by 1.
